facts.en: Completed a laboratory support diploma at Fictional Pebblewave College in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构砾浪学院完成实验室支持文凭课程。

facts.en: Attended internal chemical-label awareness training in 2024-03; it was not a laboratory analyst licence.
facts.zh: 参加 2024-03 内部化学品标签意识培训；不是实验室分析员执照。

facts.en: Stockroom trainee at Fictional Material Bench, 2023-08 to 2024-06.
facts.zh: 2023-08 至 2024-06 在虚构材料工作台机构任库房见习员。

facts.en: Laboratory logistics assistant at Fictional Material Bench, 2024-07 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2024-07 至 2026-09 在虚构材料工作台机构任实验室物流助理。

facts.en: Logs receipt dates and supplier lot numbers for sealed consumables; scientists decide suitability for experiments.
facts.zh: 登记密封耗材的收货日期及供应商批号；是否适用于实验由科学人员决定。

facts.en: Tracked 73 active consumable lines in 2026-09; the 2025-10 project peak was 108 lines.
facts.zh: 2026-09 跟踪 73 条活跃耗材品目；2025-10 项目高峰为 108 条。

facts.en: Worked with a laboratory technician on a stock-expiry register during 2025-01 to 2025-02.
facts.zh: 2025-01 至 2025-02 与实验室技术员共同制作库存到期登记表。

facts.en: Personally entered date rules and item identifiers; the technician approved storage categories.
facts.zh: 个人录入日期规则及物品标识；储存类别由技术员批准。

facts.en: The team found expired labels on 2 of 80 checked items in 2025-04 versus 6 of 75 in 2024-12; different item sets prevent a causal conclusion.
facts.zh: 团队发现，2025-04 检查的 80 件物品中有 2 件标签过期，2024-12 检查的 75 件中为 6 件；物品集合不同，不能得出因果结论。

facts.en: Drafted a barcode check-in proposal in 2026-03; no scanner purchase or deployment had occurred by 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-03 起草条码登记提案；截至 2026-09 未采购扫描器或部署。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheets, supplier packing lists, and revision-controlled inventory forms.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格、供应商装箱单及版本受控库存表。

facts.en: Reports damaged packaging to the laboratory technician without opening unknown containers or performing tests.
facts.zh: 向实验室技术员报告包装破损，不打开未知容器或执行检测。

facts.en: In 2025-07, built a personal index of 19 fictional model-kit parts unrelated to laboratory stock.
facts.zh: 2025-07 制作包含 19 件虚构模型零件的个人索引，与实验室库存无关。

facts.en: Enjoys assembling paper models and tending balcony plants.
facts.zh: 爱好组装纸模型及照料阳台植物。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Puzzle Evening in 2024-11 outside scheduled working hours.
facts.zh: 2024-11 在排定工作时间以外，为虚构拼图之夜活动做志愿者。

facts.en: A draft recommendation says performed assays; task logs record consumable receipt only, leaving assay experience unconfirmed.
facts.zh: 一份推荐草稿称执行测定；任务日志仅记录耗材收货，因此测定经验未经确认。

facts.en: A copied spreadsheet header says inventory accuracy 99% without a count or date; the percentage is unverified.
facts.zh: 复制的电子表格表头称库存准确率 99%，但无数量或日期；该百分比未经核实。

facts.en: No analytical method validation, equipment calibration authority, or independent hazardous-material handling is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录分析方法验证、设备校准权限或独立危险物料处理经历。
